assumed.status: block chance: confirmed by the user from the game's text (not checkable from a panel exported without items); block value from Strength: confirmed by the user from the game's text

client.note: Per-level rates from the client's PlayerExpectedStat table (percent per stat point), with the class constants that tie them to the panel.

note: Fitted from sheet_base.tsv and base_stats.tsv by `python -m wowcalc.rates fit`. Rates are percent per stat point, as exact fractions.

attack_power_overrides: Mage: panel fit 2 per Strength + 0 per Agility, replaced by 1 + 0 (reference)
Priest: panel fit 2 per Strength + 0 per Agility, replaced by 1 + 0 (reference)
Warlock: panel fit 2 per Strength + 0 per Agility, replaced by 1 + 0 (reference)
references.status: third party, taken from the beta client's PlayerExpectedStat table; the page labels its level 60 values 'speculation'. Crit rates are used only where they lie inside the range the character panel proves. Attack power per Strength/Agility replaces the panel fit for stat CHANGES (the user's decision where the two differ: casters 1 per Strength here vs 2 x Strength - 10 in the panel); the panel's own base attack power is never altered.
